items.title: Certificate and letter ok?
items.text: Are certificate and letter present (and vehicle registration certificates I and II)?

items.title: All documents present?
items.text: Are TUV protocols, maintenance documents (full service history) and (repair) receipts present? Has the service schedule been adhered to?

items.title: Chassis number correct?
items.text: Do the chassis no. (or Vehicle Identification No., VIN) on the certificate and on the vehicle (windscreen or engine compartment) match?

items.title: Bodywork ok?
items.text: Check the bodywork for rust and dents and look out for uneven clearances. For damage: What are the repair costs?

items.title: Paintwork ok?
items.text: Check the paintwork for scratches, blank spots or other damage.

items.title: Windscreen ok?
items.text: Are all windows ok? Look out for scratches and cracks.

items.title: Vehicle accident-free?
items.text: Can the seller guarantee it hasn't been involved in an accident? For a first owner you should insist on this. Look out for changes in colour, uneven clearances and stiff doors (signs of an accident).

items.title: Are wheels and tyres ok?
items.text: Are tyres and tread depth ok (at least 1.6mm)? Check that the tread is evenly worn.

items.title: Locks ok?
items.text: Do all the locks work? Are all keys present?

items.title: Equipment complete?
items.text: Are the spare wheel, first-aid kit and vehicle tool kit present and complete, and in good/up-to-date condition?

items.title: Engine ok?
items.text: Does the engine appear ok from the outside? Ask whether the engine has been cleaned recently. Check whether any oil spills are visible.

items.title: Battery ok?
items.text: Is the battery ok? Pay attention to charging levels and correctly secured contacts.

items.title: Tubes and cables ok?
items.text: Check that the tubes and cables are ok and not spongy. The toothed belt and fan belt should not have any rips or slack.

items.title: Seats and padding ok?
items.text: Can the seats be adjusted easily? Does the padding have holes, rips or bare patches?

items.title: No dampness?
items.text: Check for dampness under the foot mats. Steamed up windows can indicate defective seals.  Are all seals on windows and doors ok?

items.title: Seatbelts in perfect condition?
items.text: Do the seatbelts slide smoothly out and back again? Do the seatbelt clips fasten correctly? Are the seatbelts free from rips?

items.title: Are the warning lights ok?
items.text: Do all the warning lights go out after the engine has been started? Look out for flickering lights.

items.title: Lights and electrics ok?
items.text: Check the lights and vehicle electrics: wipers, electric windows, rear windscreen heater, electric mirrors. Is the interior lighting ok? Lights should not be steamed up on the inside.

items.title: Dashboard electrics ok?
items.text: Do the satnav, radio, cd player, etc. work perfectly?

items.title: Cold start without problems?
items.text: Does the vehicle start smoothly, even with a cold engine? This can't be checked with an engine that is already warmed up.

items.title: Steering ok?
items.text: The steering must not have any slack and the steering wheel must not vibrate whilst driving. The vehicle shouldn't pull in one direction.

items.title: Brakes ok?
items.text: Is the brake efficiency good? The brakes must respond smoothly, the car must hold course whilst braking.

items.title: Gears ok?
items.text: The gears should switch noiselessly, the clutch should not slip.
